newsitem.title: BELGIUM: RESEARCH ALERT - CBR UPGRADED TO 'HOLD'.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CBR UPGRADED TO 'HOLD'.

text.p: Generale Bank said it upgraded shares in Belgian cement maker CBR to 'hold' from 'sell'.

The upgrade reverses a 'sell' recommendation issued in June after the company said 1997 results would be in line with last year's earnings, below analysts' forecasts. The company news triggered various downgrades.
Generale Bank said in a research note that since June CBR had underperformed the Bel-20 index .BFX by some eight percent as well as its European peers.
"Fundamentals now point towards a fair valuation with price/earnings and price/cash flow multiples in line with or even below those of its peers," it said.
Long-term prospects remained good with CBR's presence in above-average growth regions like central Europe, Turkey and China a trump card for earnings growth, it said.
The share was indicated at 3,330 francs in pre-bourse trade, up five on Monday's close.
